ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: or unsalted butter; use olive oil for vegan and dairy-free versions

ingredients.name: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: Warm oil in a large stockpot over medium-high heat. Cook onion for about 5 minutes. Add cashews and cook until onion is translucent and nuts are lightly browned, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.

Stir in squash, stock, ginger, cumin, coriander, curry powder and turmeric. Season with salt and pepper and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat, cover and cook until squash is easily pierced, 20 to 25 minutes. Uncover and cool for 15 minutes.
Puree until smooth in small blender batches, starting on low speed, or use an immersion blender.

Return soup to the pot if needed. Add coconut milk and rosemary, cover and cook over low heat until slightly thickened, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove rosemary and serve, thinning with stock or coconut milk if desired.
